subject: general
question: Which of the following committees recommended the inclusion of a new part in the Constitution of India on Fundamental Duties of Indian Citizens?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Swaran Singh Committee**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__

• The Swaran Singh Committee was constituted by the Indian government in 1976 to review the Constitution.

• It recommended the inclusion of Fundamental Duties for Indian citizens in the Constitution.

• The Fundamental Duties were added through the 42nd Amendment to the Constitution in 1976.

• A new part, Part IVA, was introduced in the Constitution under Article 51A, listing 10 Fundamental Duties.

• The inclusion of Fundamental Duties aimed to encourage citizens to uphold the spirit of the Constitution and contribute to national unity and integrity.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• **Fundamental Duties:**

• Fundamental Duties are moral obligations for citizens outlined in Article 51A of the Constitution.

• Initially, there were 10 Fundamental Duties, which were increased to 11 by the 86th Amendment in 2002.

• These duties are non-justiciable, meaning they cannot be legally enforced.

• Examples include respecting the national flag, promoting harmony, and protecting the environment.

• **42nd Amendment Act, 1976:**

• This amendment is often referred to as the "Mini-Constitution" due to its extensive changes.

• It introduced Fundamental Duties, revised the Directive Principles of State Policy, and strengthened the central government.

• It also added the words "Socialist," "Secular," and "Integrity" to the Preamble of the Constitution.

• **Swaran Singh Committee:**

• Formed during the Emergency period (1975-77) under PM Indira Gandhi.

• Recommended both Fundamental Duties and certain changes to the Constitution to centralize power.

• Some of its proposals, such as making Fundamental Duties enforceable, were not accepted.

• **Article 51A:**

• Lists the Fundamental Duties of citizens in the Constitution.

• Encourages citizens to abide by the Constitution, cherish its ideals, and promote harmony.

• Emphasizes protecting India's heritage, environment, and scientific temper.
